facts.frequency: When needed for wheeze or breathlessness. Maximum 4 times in 24 hours.

steps.text: Use your Salbutamol inhaler. Take 2 puffs when you wheeze or feel breathless.
steps.text_en: Use your Salbutamol inhaler. Take 2 puffs when you wheeze or feel breathless.
steps.picture_prompt: A person holding a blue and grey pressurised inhaler in one hand, looking calm, plain background
steps.say: Use your Salbutamol inhaler. Take 2 puffs when you wheeze or feel breathless.

steps.text: Take the cap off your inhaler. Check the mouthpiece is clear. Shake it 4 or 5 times.
steps.text_en: Take the cap off your inhaler. Check the mouthpiece is clear. Shake it 4 or 5 times.
steps.say: Take the cap off your inhaler. Check the mouthpiece is clear. Shake it 4 or 5 times. Take your time.

steps.text: Breathe out fully and gently. Do not breathe out into the inhaler.
steps.text_en: Breathe out fully and gently. Do not breathe out into the inhaler.
steps.say: Breathe out fully and gently. Do not breathe out into the inhaler. Take your time.

steps.text: Put the mouthpiece in your mouth. Close your lips round it.
steps.text_en: Put the mouthpiece in your mouth. Close your lips round it.
steps.picture_prompt: a person with an inhaler mouthpiece in their mouth
steps.say: Put the mouthpiece in your mouth. Close your lips round it. Take your time.

steps.text: Breathe in slowly and gently. Press your inhaler once as you start.
steps.text_en: Breathe in slowly and gently. Press your inhaler once as you start.
steps.picture_prompt: a person pressing an inhaler while breathing in
steps.say: Breathe in slowly and gently. Press your inhaler once as you start. Take your time.

steps.text: Take the inhaler out of your mouth. Hold your breath for up to 10 seconds, or as long as is comfortable.
steps.text_en: Take the inhaler out of your mouth. Hold your breath for up to 10 seconds, or as long as is comfortable.
steps.picture_prompt: a person holding their breath, cheeks full
steps.say: Take the inhaler out of your mouth. Hold your breath for up to 10 seconds, or as long as is comfortable. Take your time.

steps.text: Wait at least 30 seconds before your next puff.
steps.text_en: Wait at least 30 seconds before your next puff.
steps.picture_prompt: a clock with a person waiting calmly
steps.say: Wait at least 30 seconds before your next puff. Take your time.

steps.text: If your inhaler has a steroid in it, rinse your mouth with water after your last puff. Spit the water out.
steps.text_en: If your inhaler has a steroid in it, rinse your mouth with water after your last puff. Spit the water out.
steps.picture_prompt: a person rinsing their mouth and spitting into a sink
steps.say: If your inhaler has a steroid in it, rinse your mouth with water after your last puff. Spit the water out. Take your time.

steps.text: Do not use your inhaler more than 4 times in 24 hours.
steps.text_en: Do not use your inhaler more than 4 times in 24 hours.
steps.picture_prompt: A simple 24 hour clock face with four marked segments and an inhaler beside it
steps.say: Do not use your inhaler more than 4 times in 24 hours. Take care with this one.

steps.text: In an emergency, call 999. For advice, call 111 or ask your pharmacist or GP.
steps.text_en: In an emergency, call 999. For advice, call 111 or ask your pharmacist or GP.
steps.picture_prompt: a person on the phone talking to a helper
steps.say: In an emergency, call 999. For advice, call 111 or ask your pharmacist or GP.

safety_lines_en: In an emergency, call 999. For advice, call 111 or ask your pharmacist or GP.
